directionsTap: Thepha uhlamvu lokuqala lwegama, bese uthepha uhlamvu lwalo lokugcina. Amagama atholakele anikezwa izinombolo kugridi futhi acishwe ohlwini.
directionsDiagonal: Amagama ahamba ngokunqamula, ngokwehla noma ngokutsheka.
directionsKeyboard: Ngekhibhodi: hamba ngokhiye bemicibisholo, cindezela u-Enter noma u-Space ohlamvini lokuqala bese uphinda ohlamvini lokugcina. U-Escape usula uhlamvu lokuqala.
startAt: Qala ku-{letter}, umugqa {row} ikholomu {column}. Manje khetha uhlamvu lokugcina.
